title: MemoryConflictReviewPayload
description: Payload for Memory Conflict Review tasks: the memories the reviewed memory contradicts, by reference only. Every user may read tasks while a memory may be Private or Shared, so the payload never carries what a memory says.

disputedMemory.description: An Approved memory the reviewed memory contradicts.

memory.description: The contradicted context memory, by reference.

disputes.description: Every memory the reviewed memory contradicts. A decision retried after the reviewed memory left Draft, which releases its disputes, reads them from here.
